blocks.text: Statistical modeling is a way to use data to make sense of the world and predict what will happen in the future. Think of it like this: if you want to know how much money you'll spend on groceries next month, you can look at what you spent in the past. By analyzing that data, you can create a model to help you estimate your future grocery expenses.

Example: If you usually spend around 10,000 rupees each month, but your expenses fluctuate, a statistical model can take into account factors like your family size or special occasions. This way, you can get a better idea of how much you may need to budget for your groceries of next month.
